info.title: expense.io — delivered HTTP contract
info.description: Current contract after LE-05: bounded streamed request reads, image-only OCR, reusable process pool, bounded queue and actual process termination before capacity reuse. All business routes use HA-07 Problem Details. LE-03 optional idempotence remains supported. LE-07 adds opt-in page/pageSize on four existing GET lists, deterministic secondary IDs, filtered full totals and scoped global manager search/selection. Calls without paging retain full legacy arrays until LE-11.

servers.description: Same origin as the application; no production hostname or credentials.

get.summary: Current active actor, own notes all statuses; safe allowlisted sort, no pagination. LE-07: explicit page or pageSize opts into a bounded envelope, default page1/pageSize20 and max100. Otherwise returns the full legacy array without silent truncation. Counts/totals and items share the exact same SQL snapshot and filter; offset ordering is stable only on an unchanged dataset. No frozen multi-page snapshot.

post.summary: Legacy requests without Idempotency-Key retain LE-02 upload-first behavior. With a UUID key, reserve a durable current-user/company intention, fingerprint normalized fields and exact receipt bytes, then atomically commit the complete note and original response cache. Same completed intent returns original 201 without another upload; different content, active processing or expired intent return static 409. Each retry of an incomplete intent has its own fenced attempt/receipt key.

X-Request-Id.description: UUID normalized from a valid caller ID or generated. Matches problem body requestId.

Idempotency-Replayed.description: Present only for keyed requests: true means original stored response; false means this request committed the intention. Body/status remain the same.

amount.description: Complete positive decimal string, max 99999999.99, no sign/space/exponent/suffix; bound to SQL as validated text.

expenseDate.description: Real civil date, years 0001–9999. No future-date prohibition.

description.description: Trimmed value must be nonempty and at most 4000 UTF-16 units; C0/DEL controls except tab/newline/CR are refused. Raw whitespace is trimmed. Schema maxLength counts codepoints and cannot express this UTF-16/trim policy exactly; server enforces it.

receipt.description: Nonempty File, at most 10 MiB after multipart materialization. PNG/JPEG/WebP/PDF MIME must match structural container checks. Extension derived from validated MIME, client filename ignored. Not a full decoder/antivirus guarantee.

schema.description: Exactly one occurrence of each required field. Extra fields are ignored and cannot grant user/company/role rights. Invalid/duplicate fields, malformed multipart or invalid file yield Problem400.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client intention UUID, normalized lowercase; scoped to current user+company+expense.create. Seven-day replay from first reservation. Required content fingerprint remains fixed. A processing 409 is replayable later with the same key. An expired key never creates another note; inspect history before a new intention. Header absent remains legacy, without deduplication. Repeated/malformed/empty key is 400.

post.summary: Synchronous French image OCR. Actual request bytes are bounded before multipart parsing; defaults 5 MiB file + 64 KiB multipart overhead, 12 million pixels, one reusable owned process, two queued jobs, 3s queue wait, 20s init/language/recognition deadline. Configurable bounded values; capacity is per process, not global. PDF is explicitly unsupported (415). Only successful analysis without usable suggestions returns 200 {}.

get.summary: Current HR; employee/manager users in own company (includes inactive accounts), sorted by name. No pagination. LE-07: explicit page or pageSize opts into a bounded envelope, default page1/pageSize20 and max100. Otherwise returns the full legacy array without silent truncation. Counts/totals and items share the exact same SQL snapshot and filter; offset ordering is stable only on an unchanged dataset. No frozen multi-page snapshot. role=manager restricts global candidates to active same-company managers; q is literal case-insensitive name/email search. The legacy directory still includes inactive employees/managers. selectedManagerId requires paging, resolves same-company identity outside q/page, and does not alter filtered totals.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Trimmed global literal name/email substring, max120 UTF-16 units, no controls or repeated parameter. Percent, underscore and backslash are literal. New term should start client page1.

parameters.name: role
parameters.description: Only manager is accepted. Limits candidates to active same-company managers, independently of the displayed directory page.

parameters.name: selectedManagerId
parameters.description: Requires explicit page or pageSize. Current selection identity, independent of q and page; inactive/reclassified identity is returned with isEligible=false. Foreign/missing both null. Never part of the filtered result totals.

put.summary: Current active HR; same-company employee/manager target. Explicit null removes an edge. Active same-company managers only; direct, indirect, historical and concurrent management cycles are refused. Busy candidate locks return retryable 409 without automatic retry.
